metadata.description: Verify radiational cooling signal is wired to daily HIGH, not daily LOW

finding.detail: radiational_cooling_signal.py line 18 explicitly states 'LOW market only — radiational cooling depresses overnight minima.' The signal produces directional LOW-market predictions only. It will never fire on HIGH markets. This is the correct behavior — radiational cooling affects minimum temperature, not maximum.
finding.note: For daily HIGH temp trading (our focus), radiational cooling signal is irrelevant. It should never fire in Track A/B for HIGH markets. The signal is correctly scoped.

high_temp_relevance: NONE — correctly scoped to overnight minimums
